answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the sparrow of a task receipt, and the mirror is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. What survives to the garden is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt.
